goal.objective: Prepare exact handoff-first owner mutation warrants from admitted owner work and explicitly authorized source packets, with all credential-bearing GitHub transport delegated to TVC.
success_predicates: Source-generation standing is explicit and bound to the same delta/owner
Exact TVC inspection receipt binds repository/base ref/base SHA
All mutation paths are admitted and handoff-first
Only TVC APPLY_BOUNDED_FILE_SET warrants are emitted
No credential or authority is received or created
failure_predicates: Source-generation authority is inferred from worker/model availability
Owner handoff is omitted or mutated after implementation files
Path scope expands beyond admitted owner work
Base/source hashes are missing or drifted
Credential-bearing GitHub operation occurs outside TVC
AE mathematics or canonical StegGate semantics are silently redefined

task.derivation_reason: Owner work manifests require a separate authority-preserving source-mutation preparation transition before TVC repository transport.

activation.recheck_trigger: each admitted heartbeat while owner work is ready but mutation/validation/re-observation remains unresolved

completion.next_authorized_action: Validate admitted owner/source/base evidence and emit the exact TVC APPLY_BOUNDED_FILE_SET warrant; subsequent credential-bearing execution remains TVC-owned.
terminal_when: Every actionable owner source packet is converted to an exact bounded TVC warrant or fail-closed with a machine-observable blocker
Owner mutation executor receipt is emitted
